structure.summary: Wisconsin has 72 chartered Republican county organizations. The state party constitution lets each county organization charter town, village, ward, or precinct organizations. County voting membership and any open seats depend on local party rules and rosters.
structure.source_title: Republican Party of Wisconsin Constitution, Article VIII, Section 5
structure.seat_data_source: County party bylaws and membership rosters

notes: The state party's public county directory identifies organizations and contacts, but is not a verified seat roster. No county vacancy or membership totals are inferred from it. All Wisconsin committee seat statuses remain not known.
